name: NaNGD Ultimate Toolbox
description: The ultimate Geometry Dash utility suite: Hitboxes, Practice Music Sync, Noclip, Speedhack + Audio Sync, Frame Analysis, Frame Window Counter, NanGD Bell Click, HUD, and Safe Mode.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Blocks level completion and star submissions when cheats are active.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Prevents player destruction upon hitting hazards.

show-hitboxes.name: Show Hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Renders collision boxes for player, hazards, orbs, and blocks.

practice-music-sync.name: Practice Music Sync
practice-music-sync.description: Plays normal level music in practice mode instead of the practice theme.

speedhack-audio-sync.name: Speedhack Audio Sync
speedhack-audio-sync.description: Syncs background music playback speed with the speedhack rate.

confirm-exit.name: Confirm Exit on High %
confirm-exit.description: Prompts confirmation before leaving a level if past 75% progress.

bell-click-sound.name: NanGD Bell Click Sound
bell-click-sound.description: Plays the iconic metallic desk bell sound on every click.

frame-analysis-enabled.name: High Accuracy Frame Analysis
frame-analysis-enabled.description: Measures microsecond frametimes, frametime jitter, and 1% low FPS.

frame-window-counter.name: Frame Window Counter
frame-window-counter.description: Tracks physics ticks, input frame delta, and sub-frame click offsets.

hud-show-fps.name: HUD: Show FPS
hud-show-fps.description: Show average FPS on the HUD.

hud-show-cps.name: HUD: Show CPS
hud-show-cps.description: Show live clicks-per-second on the HUD.

hud-accurate-percent.name: HUD: Accurate Percentage
hud-accurate-percent.description: Displays level completion with 2 decimal places.

instant-respawn.name: Instant Respawn
instant-respawn.description: Restarts immediately on death without animation delay.

rainbow-trail.name: Rainbow Trail
rainbow-trail.description: Continuously cycles wave & player motion streak colors.

hide-playlayer-ui.name: Clean Screen (Hide UI)
hide-playlayer-ui.description: Hides default progress bar and buttons during gameplay.
